Name: Stardew Aquarium
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pRYWq6o.gif[/img][/center][/size][size=3]Help restore the Stardew Aquarium to its former glory by donating fish for its exhibitions! See the collection come to life in full animation as you contribute to the collection. And in the meantime, why not explore the beach outside and buy a snack from the beach shop, or stock up on fishing supplies from the submarine shop if you want to try catching the rumored rare fish in these waters?

Head over to the Aquarium from your local train station today!
[/size]
[size=4][b][u]Features:[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]﻿[size=3]Two new maps: a large outdoor beach and the Aquarium.[/size]
[*]﻿[size=3]The aquarium fills up with animated fish and exhibit information as you donate fish.[/size]
[*]﻿[size=3]Three shops; the beach shop sells snacks, ice cream shop sells... well ice cream and the Submarine shop sells useful fishing supplies, its stock expanding as more fish are [/size][size=3]donated to the aquarium.[/size]
[*][size=3]Achievement and a special reward for donating all fish.[/size]
[*]﻿[size=3]Can be reached via the train station.[/size]
[*]﻿[size=3]Is that something in the waters...?[/size]
[/list]

[b][size=3]Secrets:[/size][/b]
[size=3][spoiler]This mod also adds a new legendary fish. It can only be caught on the new exterior map if you meet some specific conditions. You can donate this mysterious fish to the museum to unlock a secret room!
The conditions for catching the legendary fish:
[list]
[*][size=3]You must have caught a Pufferfish.[/size]
[*][size=3]Looted an egg, that a chicken have laid in your coop. (In Multiplayer: The chicken needs to be owned by the individual player)[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿There is a 1% chance for catching the legendary fish. This chance is increased 0.5% for every fish donated.[/size]
[/list] The legendary fish is animated with Spacecore. This can be disabled/enabled with the config.json in the [CP] Stardew Aquarium folder.[/spoiler][/size][center]

[b]How do I get to the Aquarium?[/b]
You get there by train, thanks to the Central Station framework mod. Go to the left side of the train station and click the ticket machine. A ticket costs 20 G.
The Aquarium is open from 10 AM to 9 PM except on festival days (then it's closed).

[b]How do I donate fish?[/b]
Click the counter in front of the curator NPC while having an un-donated fish in your inventory. You can click the book on the left of the counter to see the collection menu.

[b]What if I have sold/lost a legendary fish?[/b]
Aquarium does add a way to recatch legendary fish, by adding in a new "Legendary Bait" that can be attached to fishing rods. It allows the recatch of legendaries if:
1. The player has already caught the legendary previously
2. Are under the same conditions as the initial legendary fish spawn, with location, skill levels, weather, etc

When these conditions are met, equipped Legendary Bait will 100% guarantee you fish up the legendary, though you still need to play the mini-game for it

[b]Can I add this mod to an existing save?[/b]
Yes, you can safely add or remove this mod to any save at any point.

[b]Does this work on multiplayer?
[/b]Yes.

[b]Does this work on Android?[/b]
Yes. The normal donation menu however doesn't work on Android, so it is replaced with a repurposed shop menu. For each fish you can donate, it'll look like you are "Purchasing" that fish for 0 G (See media for example) . This may be improved in the future.

[b]Is this mod compatible with other mods?[/b]
Yes, we designed the mod to be compatible with as many mods as possible. [Including SVE]

[b]What about modded fish?[/b]
If you have mods that adds more fish to the game, you can donate them to the aquarium. They will also be included in the achievement for donating all the fish.

[size=3]There is currently a bug with Teh's Fishing Overhaul (the 2.1.5 unofficial update), where you will only catch trash on the new map. There is a way to fix this however. Follow the steps in this [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/topic/7452276-new-fish/page-16#entry71437033]post[/url].
Even following the steps in that post it's not possible to catch the secret legendary fish added with this mod installed. There is unfortunately nothing we can do about that on our end. You could temporarily disable the overhaul if you are trying to catch the legendary fish and then enable it again afterwards.

You can post bug reports in the "Bugs" section on this page, please remember to add a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] to the report.

[/size][b][u][size=4]Modder's reference
[/size][/u][/b]Want to add some integration to the Aquarium in your own mod? Aquarium adds mail flags and Conversation Topics that can be used to reference donations and big events!
[spoiler]
Mail flags are added to the [u]Host player[/u] for each fish donated, with any spaces removed from the Fish name, for example:  [code]AquariumDonated:RainbowTrout[/code].

For some fish ( a list can be found in Data/data.json) the exact same flag is added as a Conversation Topic for 3 days

The total number of fish are also kept track of similarly with one added for every fish. For example, if the save file has donated two fish, the host player would have the mail flags [code]AquariumFishDonated:1[/code] and AquariumFishDonated:2

When the Aquarium is completed, the mail flag [code]AquariumCompleted[/code] is added.
[/spoiler] [/center][b][u][size=5][center]
